title: Apotheosis x Point Blank Compat
description: Enables Apothic affixes and gems for Vic's Point Blank
body:
# (Unofficial) Apothic x Point Blank Compatibility

A NeoForge (Minecraft 1.21.1) compatibility bridge that brings [Point Blank](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/point-blank)'s guns into [Apotheosis](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/apotheosis)' loot and gem system, so firearms can be affixed, socketed, reforged, and enchanted the same way melee weapons and bows already are.

![gun reforging](https://i.imgur.com/iT2jDh2.png)

## Features
- **Guns can now have Rarities.** Can reforge weapons to add affixes and sockets. 
- **Splits guns into weapon classes.** Shotguns, snipers, launchers, and small arms are tagged separately so affixes and gem bonuses can be tuned per class instead of applying identically to every gun. Currently this is done manually, but should support datapacks. 
- **Adds Apotheosis gem bonuses to guns.** Existing Apotheosis gems (e.g. Breach, Tyrannical, Inferno, Molten Breach) gain an extra bonus entry scoped to guns of different classes
- **Adds gun-specific affixes.** New prefix/suffix affixes exclusive to guns, based on class and largely copying base-Apothic affixes, with some uniquely gun-focused ones.   

![modified minigun](https://i.imgur.com/LorgAbN.png)

### Future Plans:
- Magazine/ammo capacity
- further enchant-like affixes
- data/content-pack handling and support
- configs?
